graphics.kicker: STOUT INTEL / WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON OFFER
graphics.h2: THREE DOORS, AND WHAT IS BEHIND EACH ONE

cards.title: SIPS platform
items: The operations platform: pipeline, projects, clients, quotes, warehouse, tracking
Absorbs what your team already sends rather than asking them to type
Runs on your own chat channels and shared links

items.t: Narrow and honest market today: shops on a compatible system, plus chat based art departments

cards.foot: There is no signup button. That is deliberate.

cards.title: Free tools
items: Six calculators built for one working sales job
The same math that used to get done by hand on every quote
Nothing to fill out, nothing to install

items.t: Published because the math is not the product

cards.title: A portal account
items: Your live jobs, past orders and tracking
Proofs to approve on a link with no login
Messages attached to the job rather than an inbox

items.t: Built and working. Not yet handed to a client book

cards.title: How it fills itself
items: Chat channels watched, posts become records
Shared links and documents absorbed, no api needed
Inbound mail captured to a per rep address

items.t: Shipping is rate lookups only, and cannot see most shipments

cards.foot: Every field a human must type sits at 0 to 15 percent.

cards.title: What it will not do
items: Send anything to anybody without a person pressing send
Invent a delivery date the carrier never gave
Show one customer another customer, at any level
Claim a surface is finished when it is lightly used
cards.foot: The open items are published, not hidden.

cards.title: How access works
items: You request access and describe how your shop runs
I stand it up against your own channels, in the demo tenant
You see the fill rates on your own data before anything is signed
Three to five design partners first, then the next phase
